application-release-sets.title: Application release sets
application-release-sets.intro: Pin each application’s code version and independent release candidate. Review dependencies before registration; deployment uses the original plans and their individual approvals.
application-release-sets.registration_bo: A release set records a reviewed association of fixed code and candidates. It does not establish business acceptance or successful deployment.
application-release-sets.label: Release-set label
application-release-sets.association_bou: People explicitly associate each code version with a candidate. The server checks actual commits, distinct artifacts, accepted tasks and package tests from independent workers. Unsupported multiple origins remain blocked; no application build proof is invented.
application-release-sets.acknowledge_com: I reviewed unverified compatibility and dependency-declaration coverage gaps. I acknowledge only the registered exact dependencies; this does not prove complete dependencies, compatible constraints or passing tests.
application-release-sets.confirm_registr: I reviewed the exact applications, versions, candidates and dependency basis in this preview.
application-release-sets.closure_boundar: This list checks registered exact dependencies only. It does not prove complete declaration coverage, compatible constraints or passing end-to-end tests. Known incompatibility remains blocked; cycles are application groups, not execution DAGs.
application-release-sets.compatibility_a: Unverified compatibility and declaration-coverage gaps were reviewed and retained. This does not replace complete dependency analysis or independent testing.
application-release-sets.compatibility_n: No acknowledgement of unverified compatibility is recorded for this set.
application-release-sets.deployment_boun: This creates original deployment plans awaiting approval for each application. It neither approves nor starts deployment. Each plan retains its own approval, execution and health checks; this is not an atomic cross-environment release.
application-release-sets.confirm_prepare: I reviewed the fixed set, each environment and its current generation. Create plans awaiting approval only.
application-release-sets.plan_preview_re: This plan can currently be prepared
application-release-sets.no_plans: No deployment plans have been prepared.
application-release-sets.open_plan: Open original plan for approval and execution
application-release-sets.no_deployment_r: No actual deployment operation is reported. Review the original plan.
application-release-sets.receipt_project: This is the preparation receipt. Open the original plan to review current plan and deployment state.
application-release-sets.options_bounded: Options reached their bounded read scope. Unloaded objects are not necessarily absent. Review exact references before previewing.
application-release-sets.empty_hint: Register application code versions and complete their independent candidates, then explicitly associate and preview them.
application-release-sets.invalid_read: The response does not match this project, release set or original operation. Refresh and review.
application-release-sets.access_changed: Access changed. Protected release-set and plan facts have been cleared.
application-release-sets.draft_guard: Keep or discard the draft before leaving.
application-release-sets.refresh_failed: Could not refresh the current basis. Your draft is retained.
application-release-sets.plan_reference_: This member reference is bound into this plan’s hash. It grants neither group approval nor permission to deploy other applications.
application-release-sets.blocker.release: Application or governance basis changed. Review it again.
Current quality evidence does not satisfy the requirements.
Equivalent evidence is missing for this multi-origin or code source.
The candidate source does not match the fixed code version.
The current candidate no longer satisfies the requirements.
Package-test proof from an independent worker is required.
Different applications cannot reuse the same candidate or artifact.
An exact dependency version is missing from the set.
Constraint compatibility is unverified and requires explicit acknowledgement.
The environment, target site or environment generation changed. Preview again.
application-release-sets.environment_not: The current environment is outside the loaded options. Its generation cannot be assumed to be zero. Review it again; your draft is retained.
application-release-sets.blocker.release: A known incompatible dependency cannot be bypassed by acknowledgement.
